fields.description: Issue includes editorials and letters concerning the alleged beating of Charles Haynes by Miami police and criticism of the city commission’s investigation, with references to a grand jury inquiry and broader claims of official lawlessness. Additional pieces cover local politics and upcoming elections (“Political Peeps” and a call for candidates’ platform statements), dissatisfaction with restrictive policies at the new Miami High School, discussion of airport location and aviation enforcement, Community Chest fundraising, and commentary on a city resolution favoring American-made cement over imported Belgian cement and its implications for trade. Includes local news bulletins, society/campus notes, and extensive advertising.
